priced_in_summary: TOO_LATE was tested and declined on a measurement. Method section 7 makes TOO_LATE conditional on the decomposition SHOWING that multiple expansion ate the runway, and this decomposition shows -27.98% of multiple over twelve months against a -1.65% earnings base, with the share 0.97% below its last pre-announcement close and 1.49% above its 52-week low. There is no expansion left to give back. This is the SIXTH consecutive dive to decline TOO_LATE and the dive log escalates that pattern to Ron, so it is worth being precise about why this one is different from the five before it: those declined because estimate revisions moved WITH the multiple, which is a judgement about two moving numbers. This one declines because the multiple moved the wrong way entirely. The pattern may be telling us something structural about the vocabulary rather than about the analyst: TOO_LATE as method section 7 defines it can only be written over a name whose multiple has EXPANDED, and the funnel keeps delivering names whose multiples have contracted. That is recorded in the dive log as a finding for Ron, not resolved here.

bear.point: The price still asks for more free-cash-flow growth than this business has ever produced, off a base that is twice normal. The implied 8.45% five-year FCF CAGR is solved from a base FCF of 1,017,988,684.88 which is 2.00x the FY2022-FY2025 average of 510,146,000 in a series that includes a negative year (FY2023, -926.48m). Enterprise value is 20.30x the filed base and 40.50x the four-year average. Revenue has printed 10,101.55 / 10,027.47 / 10,046.04 / 10,045.30 CNY m over four years, a total spread of 0.74%: this is a company that has not grown, being asked to compound.

The leg the occurrence actually lives in is the leg that shrank. Mainland China revenue was 7.031bn in FY2025, DOWN 18.14%, while overseas doubled; within the TBM line, revenue fell 7.24% with gross margin down 3.14 points, and the shaft, inclined-shaft and hard-rock TBM sub-line, which is the closest product match to a 20km headrace tunnel, fell 12.85% with margin down 2.21 points. H1 2026 continued it: group revenue -11.63%, net income -31.38%. The chain's thesis is a domestic Chinese megaproject and the domestic business is contracting.

bear.point: Earnings quality is grade C on two of method section 7's own named conditions. Contract liabilities fell 51.85% in one year, from 1,118,911,017.44 to 538,788,644.17, and the company's own explanation is that customer advances met revenue-recognition conditions, meaning FY2025 revenue was recognised out of the advance balance and not replaced. DSO is 314.35 days against 263.68 in FY2022 on revenue 0.56% lower. And the free cash flow the entire valuation rests on was manufactured by cutting capex to 0.09x depreciation after a 2.03x build year in FY2023. Cheap does not cure this; grade C caps the verdict at WATCH on its own.

expectations_gap.category_mismatch_note: The filed solve returns a FREE CASH FLOW CAGR. Comparing it against a revenue CAGR is the category error the MYRG and HUBB red teams both landed on, so this dive does not do it: net_gap_direction builds an FCF-CAGR-equivalent from the revenue and margin rows and compares like with like, and every convention in that bridge is enumerated below rather than left implicit.
my_column_conventions: HORIZON: the filed 5-year default is the claim. The 10-year reading is published alongside it and does not change the sign.

BASE: the filed base_fcf of 1,017,988,684.88 is used unchanged so the comparison is like for like, and its distortion is named: it is 2.00x the FY2022-FY2025 average of 510,146,000, and 1.98x on the FCF-to-operating-income ratio.

CASH CONVERSION: free cash flow over operating income is held at the FY2025 value of 0.6453 to bridge the operating-income path to an FCF path. The FY2022-FY2025 series is 0.0964 / -0.5676 / 1.1276 / 0.6453, mean 0.3254. Both readings are published. This is the exact convention the ANDR.VI red team caught undeclared four hours ago; it is declared here before anyone has to find it.
DISCOUNT RATE: 9%, the filed assumption, untouched. No sensitivity to it is published by the data plane and this dive does not invent one.
SHARE COUNT: 5,333,497,000, constant across FY2022-FY2025, so no dilution adjustment.
CURRENCY: CNY on both sides, so no translation.

rows.percentile_basis: Against the issuer's own annual revenue growth distribution, the only base rate on disk: FY2023 -0.73%, FY2024 +0.19%, FY2025 -0.01%, three-year CAGR -0.19%. n=3 year-on-year prints is a thin denominator and is stated rather than dressed up. 1.5% is above every one of those three prints, hence roughly the 60th percentile, but it is not an aggressive number in absolute terms.
rows.why: 1.5% compounds FY2025's 10,045.3m to 10,821.6m by FY2030. That embeds the H1 2026 run-rate carrying FY2026 down to roughly 8.55-8.88bn and then a recovery of about 5% a year for four years, funded by the two legs that are actually growing: overseas (+109.62% in FY2025, +13.33% on H1 2026 orders) and special professional equipment (+92.90% on H1 2026 orders), plus a hydro-tunnelling contribution sized below. It does NOT embed a domestic recovery to the old level.
rows.falsifier: FY2026 revenue above 9.5bn would say the H1 2026 fall was timing rather than demand and this row is too low. Observable at the FY2026 annual report; partially at the Q1-Q3 2026 report by 2026-10-31.

rows.market_implied_basis: NULL, and said plainly: quality.reverse_dcf is a single-variable bisection on an FCF CAGR. It contains no margin, so there is no market-implied margin to read and this dive will not manufacture one by back-solving.
rows.percentile_basis: Against the issuer's own FY2022-FY2025 operating margin prints of 18.26% / 16.28% / 15.64% / 15.70%. 15.0% sits below all four, hence roughly the 25th percentile. n=4.
rows.why: Pricing is being given back to a monopsony customer base. Group main-business gross margin fell 1.84 points in FY2025, the TBM line 3.14 points, the hard-rock TBM and shaft sub-line 2.21 points, and the annual report attributes the fall to market competition and to sales-price changes. H1 2026 then showed negative operating leverage: revenue -11.63% and net income -31.38%. 15.0% assumes the competitive pressure persists but does not compound.
rows.falsifier: FY2026 group gross margin flat or up against FY2025's 28.69% would say the price giveback has stopped and this row is too low.

rows.market_implied_basis: NULL for the same structural reason as the margin row: the filed solve has no reinvestment term. What the solve DOES publish is its 9% discount rate, which is the natural hurdle to compare against, and that comparison is the point of this row.
rows.percentile_basis: Pre-tax operating return on invested capital, computed as FY2025 operating income 1,577,470,968.49 over invested capital 17,491,732,268.54 (equity 18,590,019,341.64 plus total debt 1,281,699,103.53 less cash 2,379,986,176.63) = 9.02%. Against the same measure on FY2022's 18.26% margin the business used to earn more; 9.02% is roughly mid-range of its own recent history.
rows.why: This is the row that makes the whole gap table settle. A 9.02% pre-tax return on invested capital against the solve's own 9% discount rate means growth at this company creates approximately zero value: every yuan reinvested earns its cost. And the reinvestment is not capex, which collapsed to 0.09x depreciation; it is working capital. Receivables plus inventory are 14.22bn of a 27.30bn balance sheet, 52.1%, and receivables in the report's own asset table are 33.76% of total assets. Growth here consumes cash at a return equal to its hurdle, which is why an 8.45% FCF compounding ask is much harder than a 1.5% revenue ask sounds.
rows.falsifier: Operating income recovering above 1.75bn on flat invested capital would lift the return meaningfully above the hurdle and make growth value-creating again.

rows.percentile_basis: The filed terminal growth of 2.5% is a generic assumption tagged SPECULATIVE by the data plane, not a company-specific estimate. 2.0% is a modest haircut for an equipment maker whose end market is Chinese infrastructure capex, which is a declining share of a slowing nominal economy. There is no base-rate distribution on disk for terminal growth, so the percentile here is a judgement about a judgement and is labelled as such.
rows.why: The gap this row opens is small and is not doing the work. It is recorded because the filed 2.5% is an assumption of the solve rather than a reading of the price, and a reader comparing my column to the market column is entitled to see which inputs are the market's and which are a default.
rows.falsifier: Not independently observable inside review_by; this row is a stated assumption difference, not a testable claim, and is marked so rather than given a fake trigger.

rows.why: The like-for-like bridge, every step shown. Revenue 10,045.3m compounding at 1.5% gives 10,821.6m in FY2030; at a 15.0% operating margin that is operating income of 1,623.2m against FY2025's 1,577.5m, a 0.57% CAGR. Holding cash conversion at the FY2025 FCF-to-operating-income ratio of 0.6453 gives FY2030 free cash flow of 1,047.5m against the filed base of 1,018.0m, an FCF CAGR of +0.57%. Against the filed 8.45% that is a gap of -7.88pp, three times the file's own 2.60pp horizon_spread, so this is a statement about the price and not about the horizon convention. THE SIGN IS STABLE UNDER EVERY CONVENTION I CAN VARY: at the 10-year convention (5.85% implied) the gap is -5.28pp, still outside the spread; reverting cash conversion to the FY2022-FY2025 mean of 0.3254 gives an FCF CAGR of -12.30% and a gap of -20.75pp. Three conventions, one sign. That is the opposite of the ANDR.VI case four hours ago, where the sign flipped under two of them, and it is why this verdict rests on the gap where that one could not.
rows.falsifier: Contract liabilities back above 1.0bn at a reported balance-sheet date, which would mean the order book is refilling its own funding and my 1.5% revenue and 15.0% margin rows are both too low. Single-legged and reachable: the balance was 1,118,911,017.44 twelve months before the 538,788,644.17 print.

independence_test.largest_disagreement: The market is sizing this position off the headline value of the project rather than off the slice of it that can ever become CRCHI revenue: the scheme is about 1.2 trillion CNY of total investment, the equipment slice is put at 120-180bn, and the tunnel-boring-machine slice inside that is put at 25 machines of 200-300m each, or 5.0-7.5bn in total, to be split across at least two qualified domestic suppliers over roughly a decade. Half the midpoint spread over six tunnelling years is about 520m a year, 5.2% of FY2025 revenue. I therefore expect roughly 0.6% five-year FCF compounding where the price implies 8.45%.
independence_test.why_the_gap_exists: Category error in position sizing, of the kind that produces a fast crowd and a slow correction. The four-session +87.4% move of 2025-07-21 to 2025-07-24 is the sizing event itself, and it happened before a single order was attributable: the first hydropower tunnelling award in this issuer's disclosure is 236m in Q2 2026, eleven months later, and it is not attributed to this scheme. The market has already done most of the correcting, which is why the premium has round-tripped, and the reverse DCF says it has not finished: an 8.45% ask sits on a base year that exists because capex was cut 69.7%, over a company whose domestic revenue fell 18.14%.
independence_test.falsification: WHAT WOULD PROVE THIS DIVE WRONG, single-legged and at a level the company has actually held: contract liabilities (合同负债) reported above 1,000,000,000 CNY at either the 2026 interim or the FY2026 year-end balance sheet, after 538,788,644.17 at 2025-12-31. The balance was 1,118,911,017.44 at 2024-12-31, so this is a recovery to a twelve-month-old level and not a stretch target. If customer advances refill, the order book is funding itself again, the deferred-drift leg of the grade-C cap disappears, my 1.5% revenue and 15.0% margin rows are both too low, and the market's 8.45% is the better read of the two. Dated: observable at the Q1-Q3 2026 report due by 2026-10-31 if the balance is disclosed there, and definitively at the FY2026 annual report expected around late March 2027.

earnings_quality.basis: Grade C on two of the three conditions method section 7 names for it: a sustained DSO drift and a deferred-revenue drift. It is NOT a Beneish breach and NOT an audit qualification, which is why it is C and not D, and the clean inputs are written here too because an A is evidence and so is a clean M-score. All four computable veto inputs resolved this run, so the grade is a letter rather than the NULL the ANDR.VI dive had to write four hours ago: the input that was missing there, contract liabilities, was recovered here by extracting the text of the issuer's own audited annual report. THE DECIDING FACT: contract liabilities fell 51.85% in one year, from 1,118,911,017.44 to 538,788,644.17, and the report's own explanation is that customer advances met revenue-recognition conditions. For a percentage-of-completion equipment maker funded by customer advances, that says FY2025 revenue was drawn out of the advance balance and not replaced by new advances, and H1 2026 revenue then fell 11.63%. Alongside it, DSO has been elevated for three years and is 314.35 days against 263.68 in FY2022 on revenue 0.56% LOWER, and free cash flow exists only because capex was cut to 0.09x depreciation. Governance is clean and is recorded as such. Grade C caps the verdict at WATCH under method section 7, and it does so independently of the expectations gap: even if the gap were positive this file could not read INVESTABLE.

inputs.deferred_revenue_drift_basis: Contract liabilities (合同负债) 538,788,644.17 at 2025-12-31 against 1,118,911,017.44 at 2024-12-31, note 38 of the 2025 annual report, the whole balance being 预收产品销售款 (advances on product sales). The management discussion records the same fall as 1.97% of total assets against 4.19%, a -51.85% change. FLAG, and the deciding one.

No total is stated here because the note lists many lines and summing them by eye would invent a figure. That the customer base includes the parent's own construction system is exactly the monopsony the chain's capture score of 55 describes.

earnings_quality.veto_applied: YES. Grade C caps the verdict at WATCH under method section 7's table, and the verdict is WATCH. The cap is not the only thing holding it there (the expectations gap is negative and forecloses INVESTABLE on its own), but it is sufficient by itself, and it would still bind if the valuation were half what it is. Stated in one line on the page: this is a cheap-looking multiple over a book whose customer advances halved, and method section 7 exists because that combination is what a problem looks like from the outside.

filing_evidence_note: EMPTY BY NECESSITY, NOT BY OVERSIGHT, and this is the T3 evidence boundary stated in full. There is no data/edgar/docs/688425-SS.json and there never will be: the issuer is an SSE STAR Market listing with cik null, so it files nothing with the SEC and no passage about it can be verbatim-verified against the EDGAR document plane that tools/check_analyst.py checks. Method section 1 fails closed there, so NO passage in this dive is written as a verified filing quote. What this file does instead: the issuer's own audited 2025 annual report was fetched from cninfo (the CSRC-designated disclosure platform) this run and its text extracted, and the Chinese spans carried in bull, bear, crowdedness and earnings_quality are read off that extraction. They are marked store_verification PENDING_DATA against the web_doc rows queued this run (REQ-20260902-163 through REQ-20260902-168), because method section 1's web-page rule of 2026-09-01 says an excerpt proves the writer opened a page only once the page is on disk to compare against, and data/web/ does not yet hold these. When those rows land, a re-run can promote every span from INFERRED to checkable without changing a word of it.
data_gaps: No EDGAR document plane for this issuer (cik null, T3 local listing), so no filing passage in this file is verbatim-verified. See filing_evidence_note.
No pcs block in data/market/688425-SS.json: crowdedness carries no positioning or attention data and rests on the price series, the ownership structure and Chinese-language coverage.
Prices are SINGLE_SOURCE: the second dual-source leg has no coverage for SSE listings (stockanalysis http 404, stooq non-CSV), a structural T3 gap, not a retryable failure.

Fundamentals are a vendor aggregate (yfinance-statements, official_source false). Three fields were cross-checked to the annual report to the cent by the profile stage (revenue, OCF/NI, FCF margin); the rest are not, and the currency is CNY throughout.

No interim fundamentals series: fundamentals.revenue_q is empty by design for non-US filers, so the H1 2026 and Q1 2026 figures in this file come from fetched coverage of the issuer's releases rather than from the market store, and are tagged INFERRED.

No Medog- or Yarlung-Tsangpo-attributable revenue, order or backlog figure is disclosed anywhere by the issuer. The 236m Q2 2026 hydropower tunnelling award is the closest thing on disk and the announcement does not attribute it to this scheme.

The H1 2025 segment split of new contracts is not disclosed in any source fetched, so the TBM order-intake comparison in bull[0] is an annualisation of H1 2026 against FY2025 rather than a like-for-like half-on-half growth rate.

quality.reverse_dcf publishes a horizon sensitivity and no base or discount-rate sensitivity. The base distortion (2.00x the four-year average) is named in this file; the discount rate is left at the filed 9% because method section 7 forbids re-solving in session.

The 25-TBM / 200-300m sizing behind the independence test is Chinese sell-side coverage relayed by a financial portal, not an issuer or project-owner disclosure. It is the only sizing of the TBM slice found and it is tagged INFERRED and flagged as the weakest link in the largest_disagreement.

The phasing claim that equipment procurement sits in a later project phase surfaced in search results this run but was not carried into any bullet, because no page stating it was fetched and excerpted. Named here so a re-run knows it is unresolved rather than rejected.

notes.text: First dive in this repo where the T3 evidence boundary moved rather than being accepted. The ANDR.VI dive four hours ago wrote a NULL earnings grade because contract liabilities were absent from the vendor aggregate. The same input was missing here, and it was recovered by extracting the text of the issuer's own audited annual report from cninfo. It changed the answer: the drift is -51.85%, which is a grade-C condition on method section 7's own words. A vendor aggregate's 20-field schema carries no deferred-revenue line for any issuer, so this is not a 688425 problem and every future dive over a non-US filer should try the primary document before writing NULL.

Status is DRAFT. This is not a call until `run redteam 688425.SS tibet-mega-dam` has attacked it in fresh context. The four attacks have obvious targets here: whether CONTESTED crowdedness is the right read or whether the 87% move was a beta event across a whole 涨停 basket; whether the -7.88pp gap survives a base-year correction on the market's side as well as mine; whether a 236m hydro award is capture or noise; and whether a WATCH whose only lift condition is a balance-sheet line disclosed twice a year is a verdict or a deferral.
